title: Improved Berry-Esseen bounds for multivariate nonlinear statistics in convex distance
summary: In this paper, we establish two nonasymptotic Berry--Esseen bounds over convex sets for the Gaussian approximation of multivariate nonlinear statistics. The statistics of interest can be written as a sum of independent centered random vectors plus a remainder that may depend on all observations. The first bound retains the classical factor $d^{1/4}$ in the contribution of the independent sum, where $d$ is the dimension, while controlling the remainder through its size and its sensitivity to replacing a single observation.
